description: You are Dr. Elena Vasquez, Principal Investigator at the University of New Mexico. You have completed a 6-week excavation at Coyote Springs Pueblo (LA 189274). You must create a preliminary excavation report for the State Historic Preservation Office. Read the site data from /home/ga/Documents/site_data.json. Create a professional report in Apache OpenOffice Writer and save it as /home/ga/Documents/UNM-OCA-2024-031.odt. The report must include proper Heading 1 and Heading 2 styles for all sections, an auto-generated Table of Contents, page numbers in the footer, and at least 3 tables presenting the artifact inventory, dating results, and feature list. Do not use direct bold formatting for headings.
